title: Differentially Private Model-X Knockoffs via Johnson-Lindenstrauss Transform
abstract: arXiv:2508.04800v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce a novel privatization framework for high-dimensional controlled variable selection. Our framework enables rigorous False Discovery Rate (FDR) control under differential privacy constraints. While the Model-X knockoff procedure provides FDR guarantees by constructing provably exchangeable ``negative control" features, existing privacy mechanisms like Gaussian noise injection disrupt its core exchangeability conditions. In this work we consider privatizing the data knockoff matrix through Johnson--Lindenstrauss Transform (JLT), a dimension reduction technique that simultaneously preserves covariate relationships through approximate isometry for $(\epsilon,\delta)$-differential privacy.   We theoretically characterize both FDR and the power of the proposed private variable selection procedure asymptotically. translated_title: 基于Johnson-Lindenstrauss变换的差分隐私Model-X Knockoffs方法
translated_abstract: 我们为高维受控变量选择引入了一种新颖的隐私化框架。该框架能够在差分隐私约束下实现严格的错误发现率（FDR）控制。虽然Model-X knockoff程序通过构造可证明可交换的“阴性对照”特征来提供FDR保证，但现有的隐私机制（如高斯噪声注入）会破坏其核心的可交换性条件。在这项工作中，我们考虑通过Johnson-Lindenstrauss变换（JLT）对数据knockoff矩阵进行隐私化处理，JLT是一种降维技术，通过对(ε,δ)-差分隐私的近似等距性，同时保留协变量之间的关系。我们从理论上渐近地刻画了所提出的隐私变量选择程序的FDR和统计功效。我们的理论分析刻画了隐私参数、样本量等不同因素所起的作用。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于Johnson-Lindenstrauss变换的新颖差分隐私化框架，通过降维技术对knockoff矩阵进行隐私化处理，在差分隐私约束下实现了严格的错误发现率（FDR）控制，并从理论上刻画了隐私参数和样本量等因素对变量选择功效的渐近影响。
